experiences.name: Djemaa el-Fna Square & Medina Exploration
experiences.description: Spend an afternoon and evening immersed in the heart of Marrakech's UNESCO-listed medina. Watch snake charmers, storytellers, and musicians perform in the square, then wander through the labyrinthine souks nearby. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, this experience is ideal from Day 2 onward — the square is within walking distance of riads inside the medina, so staying nearby eliminates transit time and lets you dive in immediately after breakfast.

experiences.name: Sahara Desert Overnight Camp at Erg Chebbi
experiences.description: Journey to the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi near Merzouga for a traditional Berber overnight camp experience. Ride camels at sunset, dine on tagine under the stars, and sleep in a furnished desert tent. To maximize time and avoid wasting Day 1 due to the late arrival, book a pre-dawn departure on Day 2 so you arrive at the dunes by midday. Choose a camp operator based in Merzouga village to keep logistics simple and costs within budget when booked as part of a group tour.
experiences.location: Erg Chebbi dunes, Merzouga, Sahara Desert

experiences.name: Bahia Palace & Saadian Tombs Historical Tour
experiences.description: Explore two of Marrakech's most significant historical landmarks in a single morning. The 19th-century Bahia Palace dazzles with intricate Moroccan tilework and carved cedar ceilings, while the nearby Saadian Tombs reveal the opulent burial chambers of the 16th-century Saadian dynasty. Both sites are located within the southern medina, making them easily walkable from medina-based accommodations — a key reason to prioritize staying inside or adjacent to the medina walls.

experiences.name: Traditional Moroccan Cooking Class in the Medina
experiences.description: Join a small-group cooking class led by a local chef in a riad kitchen inside the medina. Visit the nearby spice souk to select fresh ingredients — cumin, ras el hanout, preserved lemons — then prepare classic dishes like chicken bastilla, harira soup, and msemen flatbread. Classes typically run 3–4 hours and include a full meal. Staying in the medina means you can walk to the class, keeping the experience relaxed and fully immersive from the start of your day.

experiences.name: Ksar of Aït Benhaddou & Draa Valley Kasbahs
experiences.description: On your drive between Marrakech and the Sahara, stop at the UNESCO World Heritage ksar of Aït Benhaddou — a stunning fortified mud-brick village used as a backdrop for films like Gladiator and Game of Thrones. Continue through the Draa Valley, lined with ancient kasbahs, palm groves, and Berber villages. This route is best experienced as a full-day road journey, ideally on Day 2 when departing early for the desert, turning transit time into one of the trip's most scenic and historically rich experiences.
experiences.location: Aït Benhaddou & Draa Valley, between Marrakech and Ouarzazate
